scope: Qt text inventory. v2.5 editable sources are app/i18n/en.ts and sr_Latn.ts; tools/build_translations.py generates JSON fallbacks and embedded QM. Tk remains Serbian; technical diagnostics, paths and stored identifiers remain unchanged. Task022 reviews the Task017–Task021 flow, action names, preparation/consent/results, accessible text and live EN/SR bindings. Show/Hide Details refers to photo details; raw diagnostics remain under Technical details.
